name: Ridgepoint Tower
summary: Stormwind guards watch eastern Elwynn from Ridgepoint Tower, where forest roads lead into neighboring wilderness. The garrison scans the valleys for threats to the kingdom’s farms and settlements.

sections.title: Sentinel of the Eastern Border
sections.body: Ridgepoint Tower looks out from high ground at the eastern edge of Stormwind’s authority, with wild country beyond. Its guards watch the routes toward farms and settlements nearer Northshire and Goldshire. They remain alert for danger crossing the border.

sections.title: Threats on Every Horizon
sections.body: Threats press in from several directions. East lie the Redridge Mountains, where aggressive gnoll packs and blackrock orc raiders test human defenses. Across the southern river, undead horrors prowl Duskwood’s timberline. Nearby wilderness camps shelter rogue Defias Brotherhood bandits seeking gaps in the guard’s defenses.

faq.answer: Stormwind’s guards watch the kingdom’s eastern edge from Ridgepoint Tower, a fortified scout post in eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Who controls and mans the tower?
faq.answer: Guardsmen and scouts loyal to the Kingdom of Stormwind hold and garrison Ridgepoint Tower under the command of the Stormwind Guard.

faq.q: What threats does the garrison watch out for?
faq.answer: The garrison watches for aggressive gnoll packs and blackrock orc raiders from the Redridge Mountains, undead horrors from Duskwood, and Defias Brotherhood bandits in nearby wilderness camps.
Ridgepoint Tower stands on high ground in eastern Elwynn Forest, near the borders of the Redridge Mountains and Duskwood.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can take Ridgepoint Tower as a reassuring sign of safety and order before crossing into Redridge’s perilous passes or Duskwood’s haunted roads.
As a warrior, you can respect the guardsmen’s resolve as they hold this exposed border outpost against surrounding hostiles.
